purpose: Exact existential-primer constraint audit, not plaintext search, language scoring or broad family exclusion
direction: forward left-to-right; unchanged zero-based letter alignment i=0..96
primer: L independent arbitrary symbols u_0..u_(L-1), no repeating/cycling rule; K_i=u_i if i<L, then P_(i-L) or C_(i-L) in the same selected alphabet

method.plaintext: P_i=sigma*C_i-sigma*tau*P_(i-L). For i<L use root x_i=P_i. Propagate P_i=alpha_i*x_(i mod L)+beta_i with alpha_i in {+1,-1}. Each crib fixes its chain root. Conflicting fixes are necessary and sufficient contradictions; free primer symbols=L-number_of_anchored_roots; independent consistency comparisons=24-number_of_distinct_crib_residues_mod_L.
method.ciphertext: Crib i>=L checks deterministic P_i=sigma*(C_i-tau*C_(i-L)). Pre-lag cribs constrain distinct independent primer entries. Independent checks=#known_i>=L; free primer symbols=L-#known_i<L.
method.sufficiency: All root/primer coefficients are units ±1 in Z26; compatible cases have exactly26^free solutions. No arbitrary seed filling or full K4 plaintext is emitted.

unexpected_case_stop: If a compatible K4 case has zero free primer symbols, stop for independent audit and publish incomplete status rather than mislabel or claim plaintext.
vacuous: zero independent consistency checks, even though cribs still force some root/primer entries; report all such cases, never skip low-information cases

controls.synthetic_input: 97 random letters, random L-symbol primer, canonical crib positions populated from synthetic plaintext; all model combinations; independent reference ciphertext must match production encoder; full decryption and regeneration
controls.negative: For nonvacuous PT mutate one later same-residue known plaintext by +1; for nonvacuous CT mutate one known plaintext with i>=L by+1. Require contradiction. For zero-check cases the same single-crib mutation remains compatible.

oracle.patterns: empty; first=A and last=B; full first N letters of ABCD
oracle.check: Independent sequential decryption enumerates all m^L primers; compatible solution count and free exponent exactly agree with affine constraint solver. Toy enumeration is not K4 primer search.

resource_limits.stop: Atomic incomplete manifest on timeout/error; no partial run described as exhausted
